overview.description: The Vanguard Short Duration Bond ETF (VSDB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund is actively managed, investing in US and foreign fixed income securities of any credit quality, but predominantly in investment-grade bonds. It seeks to maintain a dollar weighted average maturity of 1 to 5 years, and a portfolio duration of 1 to 4 years. VSDB was launched on Apr 1, 2025 and is issued by Vanguard.
